title: MemTensor Cuts AI Memory Storage 66x With MemT-1.0 Models
summary:
MemTensor has introduced a new foundation model architecture that treats persistent memory as a core part of the computational process. This MemT-1.0 design eliminates the need to replay the full history of an interaction, enabling a 1.86x inference speedup and a 66x reduction in memory storage when handling a 128K context.

The models are built on Qwen and DeepSeek and are available in two versions: Nano, with 36B and 3B parameters, and Flash, with 288B and 17B parameters. MemTensor released Nano under an Apache 2.0 license and Flash under an MIT license.
